terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.article1Content: These Terms of Service are intended to regulate the rights, obligations, and responsibilities between the Company and users, as well as other necessary matters, regarding the use of the multilingual (i18n) management platform service (hereinafter referred to as the "Service") provided by Verbsync (hereinafter referred to as the "Company").

terms.article2ApiKey: "API Key" means an authentication key issued to use the Service's API.

However, in case of amendments to Terms that are unfavorable to users, separate notice shall be given by email in addition to the notice.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.section1Content: Verbsync (hereinafter referred to as the "Company") complies with relevant laws and regulations such as the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection, and the Personal Information Protection Act, and considers the protection of users' personal information very important. This Privacy Policy guides the items, processing purposes, retention and use periods, etc. of personal information collected in the process of using the Verbsync service (hereinafter referred to as the "Service") provided by the Company.
privacy.section2Title: 2. Items of Personal Information Collected and Collection Methods
privacy.section2Auto1: IP address, access logs, cookies, service usage records
privacy.section2Generated5: Team member information (when using team plans)
privacy.section2Method1: Direct input during membership registration and service use
privacy.section2Method2: Automatically generated and collected during service use
privacy.section2Method3: Information provided when making customer support inquiries
privacy.section3Purpose1Content: Member management, project and translation data management, API service provision
privacy.section3Purpose2Content: Usage statistics analysis, service quality improvement, new feature development
privacy.section3Purpose3Content: Inquiry response, technical support, notice delivery
privacy.section3Purpose4Content: Prevention of unauthorized use, account security management, domain-based access control
privacy.section3Purpose5Content: Payment processing and receipt issuance when using paid plans
privacy.section4Title: 4. Retention and Use Period of Personal Information
privacy.section4Content1: The Company processes and retains personal information within the personal information retention and use period according to laws and regulations or the personal information retention and use period agreed upon when collecting personal information from the information subject.
privacy.section4MemberContent: Until membership withdrawal (however, retained for the period if retention is required by law)
privacy.section4Contract: Records on Contracts or Withdrawal of Subscription:
privacy.section4Content2: Personal information is deleted immediately upon membership withdrawal, and information subject to the above retention period is retained for that period even after withdrawal.
privacy.section5Title: 5. Provision of Personal Information to Third Parties
privacy.section5Content1: The Company does not provide users' personal information to third parties in principle. However, exceptions are made in the following cases:
privacy.section5Exception1: When the user has agreed in advance
privacy.section5Exception2: When required by law or when requested by investigative agencies according to procedures and methods prescribed by law for investigative purposes
privacy.section5Exception3: Provision to external service providers within the minimum necessary scope for service provision (e.g., payment processing, email sending)
privacy.section6Content1: The Company may entrust personal information processing tasks to external specialized companies for service improvement as follows:
privacy.section6Content2: When entrusting, the Company specifies in the contract matters such as prohibition of personal information processing for purposes other than the entrusted task performance, technical and administrative protective measures, restriction of re-entrustment, and management and supervision of the consignee in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act.
privacy.section7Title: 7. Rights, Obligations, and Exercise Methods of Information Subjects
privacy.section7Content1: Users can exercise the following rights at any time:
privacy.section7Right2: Request to correct or delete personal information
privacy.section7Right3: Request to suspend processing of personal information
privacy.section7Right4: Membership withdrawal (including request to delete personal information)
privacy.section7Content2: The exercise of the above rights can be made to the Company in writing, by email, by facsimile (FAX), etc., and the Company will take action without delay.
privacy.section8Content1: The Company destroys personal information without delay when it becomes unnecessary due to the expiration of the personal information retention period or achievement of the processing purpose. The procedures and methods of destruction are as follows:
privacy.section8ProcedureContent: Information entered by users is moved to a separate database (or separate documents in case of paper) after achieving the purpose and is destroyed after being stored for a certain period according to internal policies and other related laws, or immediately.
privacy.section8MethodContent: For information in electronic file format, technical methods that cannot reproduce records are used. Personal information printed on paper is destroyed by shredding or incineration.
privacy.section9Content1: The Company is responsible for overall personal information processing tasks and has designated a Personal Information Protection Officer as follows to handle complaints and damage relief related to personal information processing:
privacy.section9Content2: Information subjects can inquire about all matters related to personal information protection, complaint handling, and damage relief that occur while using the Company's service to the Personal Information Protection Officer.
privacy.section10Title: 10. Measures to Ensure Personal Information Security
privacy.section10Content1: The Company takes the following measures to ensure personal information security:
privacy.section10Measure1Content: Establishment and implementation of internal management plans, regular employee education, etc.
privacy.section10Measure2Content: Access rights management for personal information processing systems, installation of access control systems, encryption of unique identification information, installation of security programs
privacy.section10Measure3Content: Access control for computer rooms, data storage rooms, etc.
privacy.section10Measure4Content: Passwords are stored encrypted, and API keys are managed encrypted.
privacy.section10Measure5Content: API access is allowed only from permitted domains to prevent unauthorized access.
privacy.section11Content1: The Company uses cookies to provide personalized and customized services to users. Cookies are small text files stored in the user's browser when visiting the website.
privacy.section11Purpose3: Collection of statistics for service improvement
privacy.section11Content2: Users have the right to choose regarding cookie installation and can set cookie allowance or blocking in web browser settings. However, refusing cookie installation may cause difficulties in using the service.
privacy.section12Content: This Privacy Policy will be notified through the Service's announcements from 7 days before the implementation of changes when there are additions, deletions, or modifications to the contents due to changes in laws, policies, or security technology.
